The '''Daupherm Planet States''' was an alliance of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that was extant during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The Daupherm Planet States contained more than 30 [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] inhabited by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] known as the Dauferim.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The Daupherm Planet States had a military, with which they conducted a long war against the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]]. Among the citizens of the Daupherm Planet States were [[Evram Darkmere]], [[Garreck Darkmere]] and [[Gorvan Shrulldike]].

The Botor Enclave and the Daupherm Planet States eventually joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in its early days with an [[Allied Region]] status.<ref name="TEA" />

With the vacuum of power caused by the defeat of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], both the Botor Enclave and the Daupherm Planet States declared their independence.<ref name="TEA" />
